Program name.description: Optional program header; place before declarations.

Timer trigger.description: Run on the manager's running-tick timer.

Global timer trigger.description: Run against world time with a phase offset.

Manager redstone pulse.description: React to a redstone pulse at the manager.

Named redstone trigger.description: React to a labelled redstone port.

Redstone output.description: Write a level to labelled redstone output ports.

Local declaration.description: Declare a local in a trigger, branch, loop or function block.

Program-wide RAM declaration.description: Place before functions/triggers; this shared binding lives in RAM.

Persistent state declaration.description: Place before functions/triggers; persistent data travels with the disk.

Direct assignment.description: Update an existing variable, field or array element.

Conditional.description: Branch on a typed boolean expression.

Counted loop.description: Iterate an inclusive integer range under runtime work limits.

Array or snapshot loop.description: Iterate an array or captured contents/location sequence.

While loop.description: Repeat while a condition holds, subject to shared work limits.

Typed player function.description: Place before triggers; player functions compute values and cannot perform effects.

Function return.description: Return a value of the function's declared type.

Debug print.description: Print values from a trigger to the manager's debug output.

Label handle.description: Construct a typed handle from an exact disk-label literal.

Item selector.description: Select every metadata/NBT variant of an item ID.

OreDictionary selector.description: Select an exact case-sensitive OreDictionary name.

Captured item contents.description: Capture exact item groups; optionally supply an item/ore selector.

Visible item count.description: Count matching visible items; incomplete access faults.

Empty inventory query.description: Check for no visible matching items; missing/incomplete access returns false.

Inventory availability query.description: Check supported loaded access, not stock or insertion capacity.

Transfer all visible items.description: Transfer with automatic amount; optionally append into $result.

Transfer matching items.description: Transfer selected items with automatic amount; optionally append into $result.

Transfer with aggregate cap.description: Transfer up to a nonnegative aggregate amount; optionally append into $result.

Capture transfer result.description: Append to any transfer form to declare requested/moved/remaining/status result fields.

One item per pedestal.description: Legacy IO: supply at most one item to each labelled pedestal, retaining a stock cap of one.

Typed side restriction.description: Append to a label handle; select an absolute block face.

Typed slot restriction.description: Append to a label handle; select an inclusive slot range.

Fixed array.description: Insert a fixed array of values with matching types.

Struct literal.description: Insert a fixed record with case-sensitive field names.
